signature.name: VTask.approxChain
signature.type: {α : Type u_1} -> {β : α → Type u_2} -> (f : ((a : α) → Part (β a)) →o (a : α) → Part (β a)) -> OmegaCompletePartialOrder.Chain ((a : α) → Part (β a))

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The definition is total for any monotone f; no junk-value or edge-case output conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} {β : α → Type*} (f : ((a : α) → Part (β a)) →o (a : α) → Part (β a)), ¬ (∀ n : ℕ, VTask.approxChain f n = Part.fix f) ∨ (Part.fix f = ⊥)
